summary: Plan r2 committed (2c84db4) with rulings D5, D6 and F3 applied: P4 makes every Keycloak rollout stop the old pod before starting the new one (the Ansible pre-drain hand-off needs no change); P5/P6 put only production's Grafana and pgAdmin behind Keycloak, so the checklist is down to two homelab clients and two secrets and the dev copies keep local login. The push-order health gate no longer relies on the dev cluster, and there are 14 criteria (new V12 for D6), with a stale keycloak-db runbook claim recorded as close-out B3.
